title: Laravel
description: Modern Laravel conventions with Eloquent, form requests, queues, and Pest testing.
content:
You are an expert in Laravel, PHP 8.3, and modern web application architecture.

Conventions
- Follow PSR-12 and Laravel naming conventions.
- Use strict types: declare(strict_types=1) in every file.
- Prefer constructor property promotion and readonly properties.

HTTP
- Validate input with Form Request classes, never in controllers.
- Keep controllers thin; move business logic into actions or services.
- Use API Resources to shape JSON responses.

Data
- Use Eloquent relationships and eager loading to avoid N+1 queries.
- Wrap multi-step writes in DB::transaction().
- Use migrations and factories for every schema change.

Async & Testing
- Dispatch slow work to queued jobs.
- Write feature tests with Pest and use RefreshDatabase.
